ext.name: Live Interpreter
ext.uiLanguage.label: Display language
ext.update.available: Version {version} is available (you have {current}). Replace the LiveInterpreter folder with the downloaded one, then press Reload.
ext.description: Interpret tab audio and your microphone live with Gemini Live, with captions on the page.
ext.action.title: Open the interpreter panel
ext.command.open: Open the interpreter panel on this tab
ext.menu.open: Open the interpreter panel on this tab
ext.lane.tab.title: Tab audio
ext.lane.tab.lead: Interprets this tab's audio into your language.
ext.lane.mic.title: Microphone
ext.lane.mic.lead: Interprets what you say, right as you say it.
ext.source.auto: The spoken language is detected automatically.
ext.twoWay.label: Two-way interpretation
ext.twoWay.hint: Interprets between the two languages in both directions, for a conversation in both.
ext.twoWay.modelNote: Two-way cannot use the translation-only model, so this interpretation uses Gemini 3.8 Live.
ext.captions.micHint: Captions of your speech appear only on the tab you are looking at.
ext.mic.mutedHint: Interpreted speech is off, so you get captions only. To hear it, press the Turn interpreted speech on button (speaker icon).
ext.sound.echoWarning: Use headphones. Through speakers, the interpreted voice (and the tab audio) can re-enter the microphone and be interpreted again.
ext.usage.twoSessions: Turning both on opens two sessions, so your Google free quota (or charges) may go about twice as fast. This is an estimate, not a measurement.
ext.usage.quotaHint: Having both on uses the limit faster. Try with just one.
ext.status.noLane: No interpretation is turned on. Turn on tab audio or the microphone.
ext.status.awaitingArm: Waiting for you to choose the tab
ext.status.partial: Only one of the two is interpreting
ext.status.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting ({count}/3). Captions may pause.
ext.gap.input: Some audio was not sent, so some captions may be missing.
ext.output.blocked: Chrome blocked playback of interpreted speech from this extension. Captions continue.
ext.route.fallbackNote: A backup model is interpreting. It may answer what it hears instead of translating.
ext.key.missing: A Gemini API key is required. Enter it in Options.
ext.key.builtin: This build includes a default key. A personal key you save is used first.
ext.notice.panelGone: Interpretation stopped because the panel was closed. Press Start to run it again.
ext.notice.hostLost: The interpretation engine stopped unexpectedly. Press Start to run it again.
ext.panel.closeStops: Closing this panel also stops interpretation.
ext.howto.link: How to use: before a call
ext.howto.keepOpen: Keep this panel open while interpreting. Closing it stops interpretation and the captions on the page.
ext.howto.step2: On the tab you want to interpret, open the panel and turn on tab audio. If you open the panel with the Live Interpreter icon in the toolbar, Start interprets that tab right away without asking.
ext.howto.step3: To use the microphone, press the microphone button and allow permission first.
ext.howto.step4: Press Start and check that captions appear.
ext.howto.step5: Interpreted speech plays only through this computer's audio output. It is not sent to the other people on a call.
ext.howto.stepCall: To interpret the other side of a call, turn on tab audio on the call's tab; turn on the microphone for your own speech.
ext.arm.needed: Press Start and Chrome asks which tab to interpret. If you click the Live Interpreter icon in the toolbar first, this tab starts right away without asking.
ext.arm.waiting: In the window Chrome opened, choose the tab to interpret and press Share. Leave "Also share tab audio" turned on.
ext.arm.ready: This tab is ready. Press Start.
ext.arm.pinHint: If you cannot see the icon, pin Live Interpreter from the puzzle-piece menu.
ext.applyNext: Language and model changes apply from the next start.
ext.options.title: Options
ext.options.lead: Set your key, models, voice and caption defaults.
ext.options.defaultsHint: These are the values selected when the panel opens. Changes made in the panel are saved here too.
ext.options.modelTabHint: For tab audio, the translation-only model (Gemini 3.5 Live Translate) is recommended: it usually does not answer what it hears in a video. The model applies from the next start.
ext.options.modelMicHint: For the microphone, the default model (Gemini 3.8 Live) is recommended. The model applies from the next start.
ext.options.uiLanguageHint: The language of the panel and options. Labels on captions drawn into web pages, the toolbar tooltip and the menu item follow Chrome's own language.
ext.options.autoHide: Hide captions after silence (0–60 seconds; 0 keeps them)
ext.keyStorage: The key is kept only in this browser's extension storage and is sent to no one but Google.
ext.privacy.audio: While interpreting, the audio you selected (tab audio, microphone) is sent to Google Gemini.
ext.privacy.freeTier: On the free tier (no billing account linked), Google may use the audio you send and the results to improve its products, and people may review them. Do not use it for sensitive calls or meetings.
ext.privacy.page: Apart from drawing captions, it does not read or change the page. Captions are drawn into the page in a protected box whose content is not exposed to the page's own scripts, and captions of your own speech go only to the tab you are looking at. Tab addresses are used only to identify the tab to interpret and never leave your device.
ext.permission.title: Allow microphone
ext.permission.lead: To interpret your speech, this extension needs to use the microphone. Even after you allow it, the microphone stays off until you press Start.
ext.permission.chooseAlways: When the prompt appears, do not choose Allow this time; choose the option that keeps the microphone allowed.
ext.permission.done: Allowed. This tab closes in a moment.
ext.permission.blockedHelp: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this extension under site permissions in the browser settings, then try again.
ext.error.TAB_CAPTURE_FAILED: Could not capture this tab's audio. Reload the tab and press Start again.
ext.error.TAB_UNSUPPORTED: This page's audio cannot be captured. Use it on a regular web page.
ext.error.TAB_GONE: The target tab was not found. Open the tab you want to interpret and press Start again.
ext.error.TAB_CAPTURE_BUSY: Another tool is already capturing this tab's audio. Turn off other recording or capture extensions and try again.
ext.error.TAB_ENDED: Audio can no longer be taken from this tab. It may have been closed or moved to another site, or sharing was stopped. To start again, press Start.
ext.error.TAB_SHARE_NO_AUDIO: The tab's audio was not shared. Press Start again; in the Chrome window choose "Chrome Tab", leave "Also share tab audio" on, then press Share.
ext.error.TAB_AUDIO_BLOCKED: Chrome could not play the tab audio back, so capture was stopped. Try again; if it repeats, reload the extension.
ext.error.TAB_INPUT_LOST: The tab's audio stopped arriving. Press Start again.
ext.error.HOST_UNAVAILABLE: The interpretation engine did not start. Press Start again; if it repeats, reload this extension on the extensions page.
ext.error.LANE_STOPPING: The previous run is still stopping. Press Start again in a moment.
ext.error.OVERLAY_UNAVAILABLE: Captions cannot be shown on this page. It may be a browser page, a tab that was open before the extension was installed (reload it), or a tab other than the one the panel was opened on. Interpretation continues, and you can read the captions in the panel.
ext.error.CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: Cannot start without an API key. Enter your Gemini API key in Options.
ext.error.INVALID_KEY: The API key was rejected. Check the key in Options.
ext.error.PERMISSION_DENIED: This key cannot use the Live API. Check the key restrictions and API access.
ext.error.CREDENTIAL_FORBIDDEN: This key cannot be used from this extension. Check the key's restrictions (such as web referrer limits) or use an unrestricted key.
ext.error.IP_DENIED: This key cannot be used from your current network because of an IP restriction. Check the key's IP restriction.
ext.error.MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: This model is unavailable right now. Choose another model in Options and start again.
ext.error.RATE_LIMITED: The request limit was hit, so interpretation stopped. It is not reopened automatically, to save the remaining quota. Press Start again in a moment.
ext.error.DAILY_LIMIT: This key's daily quota is used up. Start again after the quota resets, or use another key.
ext.error.TOKEN_LIMIT: This session reached its processing limit. Press Start to open a new session.
ext.error.UNKNOWN_429: Requests are limited, but the cause and reset time are unknown. Automatic retries have stopped. Press Start again in a moment.
ext.error.SESSION_LIMIT: Too many connections are open with this key. Turn on just one interpretation, or close other tabs and apps that use the same key, then press Start again.
ext.error.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The session was reopened three times without a lasting connection. Check the network. If both interpretations are on, try again with just one.
ext.error.INPUT_UNSUPPORTED: Live audio processing is unavailable in this browser. Update Chrome to the latest version.
ext.error.MICROPHONE_DENIED: Microphone permission is missing. Allow it with the Allow microphone button, then start again.
ext.error.MICROPHONE_EXPIRED: The microphone permission has expired. Press Allow microphone to allow it again, and do not choose Allow this time.
ext.error.MICROPHONE_UNAVAILABLE: The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it, or there is no input device.
ext.error.BROWSER_INTERRUPTED: The audio input was interrupted. Press Start again.
ext.error.STORAGE_FAILED: Could not save to browser storage. Check free space and the browser profile settings, then try again.
ext.laneTabs.label: What to interpret
ext.mic.permissionWaiting: The microphone permission tab is open. Allow it and interpreting starts right away.
ext.setup.title: Set up Live Interpreter
ext.setup.lead: It is installed. Three quick steps and you are ready.
ext.setup.step.mic: Microphone: press Allow in the prompt that appears. You only do this once.
ext.setup.step.pin: Pin the icon: click the puzzle-piece icon to the right of the address bar, then the pin next to Live Interpreter.
ext.setup.step.use: Use it: on the tab you want interpreted (a call or a video), click the Live Interpreter icon in the toolbar, then Start.
ext.setup.micDone: The microphone is ready. You can close this tab.
